components.name: Port Ident
components.description: The channel number: a square tile in the service's tone (mint server, violet container, yellow past threshold, gray tool).
components.html: 7000
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-ident { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 56px; height: 34px; padding: 0 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font-family: "JetBrains Mono Variable", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-server { background: var(--mint, #00ca72); color: var(--ink, #111226); } .ds-container { background: var(--blue, #6161ff); color: #fff; } .ds-review { background: var(--yellow, #ffcc00); color: var(--ink, #111226); } .ds-tool { background: var(--tool-block, #23264a); color: var(--text, #f4f3ff); cursor: default; } button.ds-ident:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-ident:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #b7b7ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-track { position: relative; height: 62px; background: var(--surface, #0e1024); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #23264a); } .ds-tick { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: var(--rule, #23264a); } .ds-threshold { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 1px; z-index: 2; background: var(--yellow, #ffcc00); } .ds-now { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; z-index: 3; background: var(--now, #6161ff); } .ds-block { position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 0; transform: translateY(-50%); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 28px; padding: 0 9px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0; font-family: "Archivo Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--text, #f4f3ff); } .ds-block-server { background: var(--server-block, #0f3b31); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--mint, #00ca72); } .ds-block-review { background: var(--yellow, #ffcc00); color: var(--ink, #111226); } .ds-mono { font-family: "JetBrains Mono Variable", monospace; font-size: 11.5px; } .ds-arrow { width: 0; height: 0; border-block: 5px solid transparent; border-right: 7px solid currentColor; }

components.css: .ds-rail { width: 244px; padding: 18px; background: #181b34; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 10px; margin-bottom: 3px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #c7c9dc; text-align: left; font-family: "Archivo Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav:hover { background: #23264a; color: #fff; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b7b7ff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-active { background: #6161ff; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; } .ds-active:focus-visible { outline-color: #fff; } .ds-nav-count { margin-left: auto; font-family: "JetBrains Mono Variable", monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-warn { padding: 0 5px; background: #ffcc00; color: #111226; font-weight: 700; }

components.css: .ds-heat-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-cpu { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 54px; height: 26px; font-family: "JetBrains Mono Variable", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--h3-ink, #111226); } .ds-trail { position: relative; flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; padding-right: 12px; height: 34px; } .ds-trail::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 8px; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: var(--now, #6161ff); } .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; width: 100%; height: 20px; } .ds-h0 { background: var(--h0, #171a3c); } .ds-h1 { background: var(--h1, #0f3b31); } .ds-h2 { background: var(--h2, #0b6a4b); } .ds-h3 { background: var(--h3, #009a59); } .ds-h4 { background: var(--h4, #00ca72); }

narrative.overview:
Every service is a channel on a broadcast programme guide. Its port is the channel number, shown as a square colour ident; its lifetime is a programme block running along one shared time axis up to a violet "now" line. The Processes view uses the same grammar: each application is a row whose last two minutes of CPU run as a strip of heat cells into the same now line. The world refuses the category default of stat cards over a table: counts live in filter chips, measurements live in rows and strips.

The system is dark-first (used at night beside a dark terminal and editor) and the light theme follows macOS at the same finish. Density is high and tabular: fixed per-row furniture, mono figures, no ornament around measurements. Colour is quarantined to marks (idents, blocks, keys, meters, the now line, stop squares); text stays ink or secondary gray. Every box is square, every contour is 1px, and there are no offset shadows. The human rationale, in French, lives in `docs/design-decisions.md`; product truth lives in `PRODUCT.md`. This file is the agent-facing system record and does not repeat them.

Two views share one vocabulary: the **programme guide** (default) and the **simplified view**, switched by the `simpleView` setting and by the "Simplified view" toggle in the top bar. The simplified view is the same world with less furniture, never a second style.
keyCharacteristics: Square everything: `border-radius: 0` on every element and pseudo-element, including redrawn checkboxes, selects and Lucide icon caps.
Four Monday hues with strict jobs: mint server, violet container and now line and selection and focus, yellow status only, pink stop only.
A navy rail (`sidebar`) that anchors navigation in both themes.
Archivo Variable with condensed widths for headings and names; JetBrains Mono Variable for ports, PIDs, figures, durations and commands.
One shared time axis per view; length on the axis is exact duration.
Flat surfaces separated by tonal steps (`raise`, `head`) and 1px lines.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Each Monday hue has one meaning. Mint is a server, violet is a container or "now" or selection or focus, yellow is a status that needs a look, pink is stop. A new feature reuses a meaning or uses a neutral; it never paints a hue for decoration.

rules.name: The Ink Text Rule
rules.body: Text stays `text`, `muted` or `quiet`. It never takes a series colour. On mint, yellow and pink the text is `ink`; on violet it is white.

rules.name: The Fact, Not Alarm Rule
rules.body: Network exposure is an outlined square (a 1.5px inset stroke in `currentColor`), next to the filled mint "local" square. It is never yellow or pink.

rules.name: The Ink Edge Rule
rules.body: In light mode, yellow marks (ident, block, keys, age meter) carry a 1px `ink` edge; the review threshold line turns ink.

rules.name: The Mono Number Rule
rules.body: Every port, PID, duration, percentage, byte count, time and command is JetBrains Mono with tabular figures. Words are Archivo.

rules.name: The Condensed Name Rule
rules.body: Width compression is for headings and names only (84%, 85%, 92%); body text stays at normal width.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: No offset or decorative shadows, no blur, no layout motion on hover. If something needs to stand out, change its tone or its 1px contour.

dos: **Do** keep `border-radius: 0` on every new element, pseudo-element and native control; redraw any control WebKit rounds.
**Do** colour a service by the One Job Rule: mint server, violet container, yellow past the review threshold, `tool-block` gray for tools.
**Do** put every number, port, PID, duration and command in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
**Do** place time-based marks on the view's shared axis and end them at the 2px violet now line.
**Do** pair every colour state with a word or icon, and give yellow a 1px ink edge in light mode.
**Do** separate surfaces with tonal steps (`raise`, `head`) and 1px `line` / `rule` contours.
**Do** build a new view in both the programme guide and the simplified view, with the same tokens.
**Do** keep text in `text`, `muted` or `quiet`; ink on mint, yellow and pink; white on violet.
donts: **Don't** round anything, including checkboxes, selects, keys, meters, icons or dialog corners.
**Don't** use offset shadows, glow or blur; contours are 1px.
**Don't** use yellow for anything but status, or pink for anything but stop.
**Don't** show network exposure as a warning colour; it is an outlined square.
**Don't** put stat cards or coloured count tiles above a list; counts live in filter chips.
**Don't** colour text with a series hue, or give projects yellow or pink squares.
**Don't** estimate a missing measurement; show "—" and say it is not exposed.
